profile.pronunciation_convention: IPA (Latin American, seseo); spoken = stress hint
profile.grammar_notes: Two copulas: ser (identity, origin, job) and estar (location, temporary state); hay for existence. Pro-drop: subject pronouns optional, verb endings carry person. Negation with no before the verb. Questions by intonation plus question words (qué, dónde, cuándo, cómo, quién, por qué). Modal jobs: querer (want), poder (can), tener que (must), ir (go), venir (come), tener (have). Politeness marked grammatically: tú vs usted; ustedes is the only plural 'you' in Latin America (no vosotros). Gender on nouns with articles el/la; object pronouns lo/la/le; reflexive se. Past: preterite vs imperfect aspect. Closed sets: subject pronouns, question words, articles, demonstratives, possessives.
